name: Context7
description: Current library documentation and code examples. Bundled; public queries work without an account and may be rate limited.

name: Websearch
description: Web search and URL reading with account-free provider fallback. Search queries go to public third-party providers; availability and rate limits vary.

name: Codegraph
description: Local code architecture, AST symbols, references and search. Bundled native engine; lexical search works offline, model downloads and plugin adoption are disabled.

name: Language Servers
description: Semantic navigation and diagnostics. Installs TypeScript/JavaScript language support; other languages need their own language servers on PATH.

name: Local Ripgrep
description: Local file search, counts and file listings. This is mcp-ripgrep (also called grep_app), not the remote grep.app service. Installs the native search binary.

name: GitHub
description: Official hosted GitHub MCP server. Supply a personal access token with permissions for the repositories you want to use; no CCode account is needed.

name: n8n
description: Workflow tools for your own n8n instance. Provide its base URL and n8n API key; no existing installation credentials are imported.

configFields.label: n8n API key
configFields.placeholder: Generated in n8n Settings → n8n API

name: Obsidian Vault
description: Read and edit Markdown notes through mcpvault. Select your vault folder; Obsidian does not need to be running.

configFields.label: Vault folder
configFields.placeholder: Absolute path to a Markdown vault
